purpose: Predeclared longer-generation replication of the same exact published internal edit, with batched inference and fresh synthetic inputs; no independent edit discovery.
attribution: Takehi, Teoh, Zhang and Khattab, Sparks of Weight-Space Programming; published patch CC BY 4.0. https://github.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs/tree/main/exp8_math

data.kind: Fresh procedural integer arithmetic, four equally represented families, plus exact-string instruction guardrails
data.seed_policy: Generate one fresh remote 256-bit seed after choices are frozen. Exclude all arithmetic IDs from loop-repair-03 and previous phases; collision rejection uses IDs only, never outcomes.
data.isolation: Coordinator controlled, not independently qualified. No former classification records reused. Final choices fixed before any final input is generated or evaluated.

selection: None. Same predeclared published patch. Same prompts, decoder settings, batch membership and batch sampling seed in both arms; alternate arm order by batch. No optimizer, fitted classifier, adaptive patch or prompt tuning.
uncertainty: 95% paired case-bootstrap interval, 10000 resamples, fixed seed 0; exact paired one-sided binomial test on discordant cases. Small synthetic cohort; no claim about general math ability or unrelated capabilities.
failure_policy: Write intent before each generation; retain errors and partial results. Never retry scored cases or overwrite this run. Any runtime/budget failure makes success unavailable. No token-bound changes after readings.

runtime_invariants: published patch bytes and base/edited hashes
exact unchanged synthetic logits after restoration
long-context batch timing and memory preflight

differences_from_original: fresh synthetic arithmetic rather than source benchmark
Transformers SDPA batched inference rather than vLLM
published patch reused rather than independently discovered
guard copy tasks use thinking disabled identically in both arms
next_stage: No third trial under this registration or goal family. A third requires a separately justified plan and valid multiplicity handling, fresh data and remaining authorized budget.

multiplicity.method: Bonferroni over two planned trials, loop-repair-03 and loop-repair-04
multiplicity.prior_trial_note: Preserve trial03 original p<=.05 stage rule; any overall goal claim from either trial additionally requires adjusted p<=.05. This family is frozen before trial03 final or guard outcomes are inspected.

admission.prior_trial: loop-repair-03 must be terminal and its closure audit pass; skip this trial if its goal-adjusted result already meets the objective
admission.hard_stop_utc: <set your authorized UTC deadline before registering a new trial>
admission.total_caps: Original private total compute and storage caps remain binding. A reproduction needs its own authorized caps before registration.
admission.preflight: Eight synthetic 16384-token contexts followed by 128 forced-length, unscored new tokens using SDPA. Record time, memory and restoration. Require conservative estimated remaining generation time plus 300 seconds <=90% of remaining stage wall time and before closure reserve; otherwise stop before new questions are generated.

differences_from_trial03: batch8 with fixed paired batch seeds instead of one sequence at a time
both native and chat EOS stop tokens
Bonferroni-adjusted goal claim across two planned trials

publication.projection: Package/cache names generalized; private operating deadline and total account caps withheld. Numeric scientific bounds unchanged. Set authorized resource limits and register before any new execution.
